gen-mystery-quest-mulish: Mulish traces every stroke at the width of a single stylus, with short ascenders over a large x-height. And Mystery Quest handles the bookish nostalgia with open-jawed curves, leaving Mulish to be the modern, approachable one.
gen-comfortaa-fs-amulya: A neon-tube line runs unbroken through every Comfortaa letter, from terminals to junctions, with a ring-like c and stretched spacing. Amulya, with its generous curve gaps, can sit comfortably small.
gen-comfortaa-fs-roundo: Comfortaa draws a ringlike c and neon-tube strokes, spaced out like an uncoiled spring. Roundo brings neutral, geometric text, its n arch matching the stem and its small counters never clogging.
gen-comfortaa-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps its vertical and horizontal strokes identical in weight, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Comfortaa then takes the headline spot with friendly geometry, neon-tube strokes and stretched spacing.
gen-comfortaa-fs-synonym: Synonym is built from a constant stripe of ink, with every curve left generously open. Synonym handles the dependable reading, while Comfortaa saves its ring-shaped c and neon-tube friendliness for the top.
gen-comfortaa-plus-jakarta-sans: Rings and neon tubes: Comfortaa draws its c as a wide ring, with stretched spacing. Plus Jakarta Sans, monoline with curve endings kept well apart, can drop a size smaller.
gen-comfortaa-sora: Sora keeps its curves free of any pressure swell at the corners, with a c and s that stay widely parted. Comfortaa adds ring-like friendliness up top; both stay geometric.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, its tall body making the ascenders look short, with curve endings kept well apart. And Alien Encounters adds otherworldly, technological gaps between its letter pairs above it.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-hind: Big, open gaps between letter pairs and a high x-height make Alien Encounters feel otherworldly and technological. Hind sets lowercase nearly level with its capitals and draws steady strokes, a quiet foil.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-nunito: Nunito rounds its lowercase bowls big and lets its terminals finish well clear of the stem. And Alien Encounters stretches out with otherworldly, technological gaps between letters, a wide counterpart to that softness.
